name: Asag
subtitle: Grotesque Golem
description: Petrify your opponents and burn them as you attack your foes.
lore: A great demon of burning malice, Asag was once bound to the mountains of Ekur, able to descend only in the winter. Since the Shattering, however, his nature has shifted and he is no longer bound by location or season. His rampages are unpredictable, and so violent they can leave entire communities obliterated in his wake.
divinity_generator: Gain [10] Divinity when enemies are damaged by [Blaze]

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: Crushing Force
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (8%HP+120%ATK). If the target is under [mechanic:petrify] or [mechanic:blaze], increase the damage inflicted by 20%.

skills.name: Magmaburn
skills.description: At the end of an enemy turn, if they are under [mechanic:blaze], has a 50% to place [mechanic:petrify] on them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Seismic Surge
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (16%HP+130%ATK). If the target is under [mechanic:blaze], Heal 10%HP this hero. If the target is under [mechanic:petrify], has a 10% additional chance to Strong Hit.

skills.name: Molten Smash
skills.description: Attack all enemies (11%HP+90%ATK) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:blaze-i] on each target for 1 turn. If the target is under [mechanic:petrify], will place [mechanic:blaze-ii] instead.
